# Capability matrix

What MowDeck can do with the mowers of each provider, per model family. The page is generated from the adapters' code ([ADR 0071](../adr/0071-capability-matrix.md)): every provider declares a capability profile per model family, whose capabilities its own capability code computes for a representative mower, so the matrix changes with the code and is never edited by hand. A connected mower shows its exact capabilities on its own page; they can be narrower than its family's (an older firmware, a missing module, a link that is down).

## Legend

| Mark | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| yes | MowDeck supports it on every mower of the family. A detail after the colon shows the range or the choices of a representative model. |
| varies | Depends on the exact model, the firmware, an add-on module, a link or the setup in the vendor's app; see the family's notes. |
| not offered | The mower or its vendor's API does not offer it, so MowDeck cannot. |
| not yet | MowDeck does not support it yet for this family. |

*Start, pause, resume, return to dock, emergency stop* are part of every connection (ADR 0012); how a mower carries out an emergency stop differs, see the notes. Safety rules are the same for every provider: the controller refuses what a mower does not declare before the vendor is asked.

## Husqvarna Automower Connect

Husqvarna Automower (and Gardena smart) mowers through the official Automower Connect API: state, battery, errors, GPS position on models with GPS; start for a duration or in a work area, pause, resume the schedule, park. No maps, patterns or manual driving.

- provider id `husqvarna`
- error lexicon: 180 codes (de, en)
- off by default (operators enable it)
- needs a developer account at the vendor

!!! note "Not tested on real hardware"
    Built and tested against recorded vendor data and a fake cloud only.

| Model family | Device models | Tested on real hardware |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Automower and Gardena smart | `Husqvarna Automower (Automower Connect)`, `Gardena smart SILENO` | no |

## Worx Landroid, Kress, LandXcape

Worx Landroid, Kress and LandXcape mowers through their shared cloud (unofficial API, push over MQTT): state, battery, errors with lift alarms, rain sensor, GPS position on models with a GPS module; start now, in a zone or along the edge, pause, send home; rain delay and cutting height where the mower has them. No maps, patterns or manual driving.

- provider id `worx`
- error lexicon: 37 codes (de, en), 37 unverified
- off by default (operators enable it)

!!! note "Not tested on real hardware"
    Built and tested against recorded vendor data and a fake cloud only.

!!! warning
    Unofficial API: MowDeck talks to the cloud the way the brand's app does. The vendor does not document or support this interface; it can change or stop working at any time.

!!! warning
    Account block risk: the vendor has temporarily blocked accounts that logged in or polled too often. MowDeck logs in once per account, lives on push updates and waits after a refused login, but cannot rule a block out. Prefer a second account the mower is shared with.

## Adding to this page

A provider declares its profiles in `ProviderSpec.capability_profiles` ([Cloud providers: adding a vendor](../dev/cloud-providers.md)); run `uv run poe capability-matrix` and commit the page. CI fails (`uv run poe capability-matrix-check`) when the page and the code disagree.
